## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request changes, why it is needed, and link any related issues.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] :bug: Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] :sparkles: New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] :boom: Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] :recycle: Code refactor / optimization
- [ ] :memo: Documentation update
- [ ] :white_check_mark: Tests update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the style guidelines of this project (`npm run lint` passes without errors).
- [ ] I have built the application locally (`npm run build` succeeds).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly (if applicable).
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, private API keys, or tokens are included.

## Screenshots / Verification
Please provide visual proof, terminal outputs, or before-and-after screenshots if applicable.
